_about: The other MRRS police talkgroups (Harrison PD, MTA PD, the interop talkgroups) with the police pack's rules ("rules_from": sizeup/intel/rules.py rules_from(): its categories, rules and suppress phrases as data/intel/police.json writes them; rule ids "area.<id>", labels "Area PD: <label>"). LOG ONLY: events in the store and the log, never the map, the card or a push, until an admin raises the pack in Settings > System > Intel (its categories and rules are the police pack's, at push). Scope: every MRRS police talkgroup except the police pack's own ("exclude" = police.json's sources; tests/test_intel_scope.py holds the two together). No towns (they aren't ours), no model ("infer": false).
